title: Hatsune Miku — How About Tickling?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... Your dance routine?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. We learned to do this fun dance routine and were hoping you could see it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, but what do you mean by a “fun” dance routine...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Just sit back and find out♪
Here we go... One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? No music?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I guess not.
And they seem to be dancing like they usually do...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But they're changing their tempo or rhythm here and there at some interesting points...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, and this looks familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, is it...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I think KAITO knows.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is actually the dance we've been working on but in reverse.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-In reverse?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's astounding! Now I see what you meant by “fun”!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Airi shows us some videos of these kinds of dances, so we decided to give it a try♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's definitely what we've been practicing, but it looks completely different...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Miku, this means...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes! It's the same but not.
It's the same but new...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This might be just what I need for my show!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I remember you three discussing that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. But I'm still amazed at how you can dance in reverse like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It can't be easy to master.
Nor is it something you'd normally think of doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But there were so many other videos like this. Some reversed each side-to-side motion and others involved dancing like you're looking at yourself in the mirror.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They were so interesting that MEIKO, Airi and I ended up watching quite a few of them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, I guess there really are a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's the matter, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I became too focused on my theme.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My goal was to put on a show that let me get back to my roots, but that seems to have given me tunnel vision in terms of ideas...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Revisiting my roots while hoping to try some new things sort of doesn't make sense now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I got so caught up in doing a show on my own that I'd forgotten about what I actually wanted to do during it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I believe that's sort of nice every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, good chunks of most shows are usually put together through feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. We're allowed to choose which songs we want to sing, all the effects we wish to try and a whole list of other things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly! It's important to “do all the things you want” every so often during a show, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree! Having a theme or concept in mind is important, but seeing you driven by passion would be very new to all of us, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Driven by passion...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(That reminds me...
When I was just starting to do shows in this SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone! We have so many songs in store for you today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, Rin, ready♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what to do during a show other than singing as many songs as I could.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know what I want to do now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm going to sing all the songs I want to sing with absolutely everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because that's all I really did when this SEKAI was first born. I sang and sang and sang.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't know that either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that going back to my roots like this will show all of you a new side of me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I think it's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing your show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me three.
I can't wait to see this new side of you, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Same. I'll be looking forward to it as well!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Stay tuned and get ready for the hottest Miku show you've ever seen♪
